notes.title: #DEVELOPMENT NEWS# / 1 / The Lost In The Backrooms
notes.content:
hello everyone! 2 months have passed since the latest news, during this time there have been several interesting news and I can't wait to share them with you! 

What is this monthly column? Why is the price of Scaper Dash now so high? What's with the new game? When is she coming out? Will I get it if I have a Scaper Dash? Now you will find out everything :)


What is the #DEVELOPMENT NEWS# category ?


This is a new monthly column dedicated to the development of my new game, The Lost In The Backrooms! At the beginning of each month I will publish various news related to this game. Also, I will publish screenshots and various mechanics that you can always evaluate in the comments!

P.s.   The name of The Lost In The Backrooms is not final and may change.


Why is Scaper Dash worth so much?


I think that I should not conceal the truth, and therefore I will say... [spoiler] I did this so that no one could buy the game temporarily, I don't want people to buy raw product. Therefore, I have plans to release the final update for Scaper Dash, after which I will lower the price again.[/spoiler]


 What's up with the new game?


The development of The Lost In The Backrooms  is progressing successfully! Most of the time I was working on Level 0. This game is supposed to be THE MOST THOUGHTFUL GAME ABOUT BACKROOMS (if of course everything goes according to plan). Since then I have been working on Lighting and  myselfLevel 0 and I'll say this, I did about 1/4 of the whole level, it should be Incredibly large. Also, I want to explain right away, I'm making this game using Backrooms Wiki, so I'll take most of the ideas from there. For example, each level in the game will have its own Sublevels . I will add all of them in accordance with the above Wiki. Also, I want to show you a couple of screenshots from the game:

When is she coming out? 


I can't say the exact release date yet, but I can say for sure that the game will be released after the first quarter of 2024! I will try to make it as high-quality and optimized as possible.


Will I get it if I have a Scaper Dash?

 YES!

Everyone who has previously purchased Scaper Dash will receive The Lost In The Backrooms  for FREE! But if you didn't have time to buy Scaper Dash, then don't worry! Now you will find out why)


Future plans...


[olist]
My immediate plans are to release an update for Scaper Dash, bring it to the end and reduce the price.
Create a Discord Server where you can chat, as well as watch the news before everyone else!) In it, I also plan to conduct sweepstakes, as well as give out Beta-test games! 
Next, I plan to create the following Sublevels: 0.01 ; 0.1 ; 0.8 ; Manila Room. I will start making them after Level 0 is finished.
[/olist]


Well, I think that's it! Write your ideas and what you think about the game in the comments! Until next month!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 1/3
notes.content:
Textil Update
Hello to all Scaper Dash fans! Today we want to present you 1 of 3 major updates, namely Textil Update. 

 Textil Update 

In this update, we have changed the following:
- Font at all levels;
-3 new levels:
- Aaand... um... thats all :P
Okay, not really! We also changed the graphical settings of the game (this is necessary for further updates).

In this update, we have worked mostly on optimizing and preparing the game for the next updates.

What kind of updates, you may ask. And we will tell you, these are the 2 nearest updates-Laval Update and
Menul Update.

 Laval Update 

In Laval Update, we will add new levels, many different levels, we will add what this game needed from the very beginning, a save system. Well, in fact, this function will appear only in Menual Update.

 Menual Update 

In the Menual Update, we will add a full-fledged interface, settings, 1 new language (English), various levels and a save system. Remember we talked about the fact that we cut the schedule? So, this had to be done to test the graphics settings and promote the plot. We will not reveal all the cards at the expense of the plot, but believe me, we will not let you down.

In fact, this is one huge update divided into 3 regular ones, but there is still a lot of content in each of them.

Thank you for being with us,
With love
OneRoadStudios ♡!
